body: Standardized Distributed Generative and Predictive AI Inference Platform for Scalable, Multi-Framework Deployment on Kubernetes
plain_description: KServe is one standardized platform for deploying all your AI models — from LLMs to traditional ML models — on Kubernetes without juggling multiple tools. It handles autoscaling, safe rollouts with traffic splitting, and built-in monitoring so your team can focus on improving models instead of managing infrastructure. The bottom line: faster, safer AI deployments at lower operational cost.
technical_description: KServe is a Kubernetes-native inference platform that provides a standardized InferenceService API for deploying generative and predictive AI models at scale. It supports multiple serving runtimes including vLLM for LLMs and native runtimes for TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and ONNX. The platform implements canary rollouts, request-based autoscaling with scale-to-zero, model explainability, payload logging, outlier and drift detection, and InferenceGraph for complex request routing. Client integration is via OpenAI-compatible REST and gRPC protocols. The control plane is implemented in Go with Python serving runtimes.
title: KServe
